purpose: Separately composed illustrative challenge cases; not professionally reviewed, not used for fitting or model selection.

cases.text: Everything I used to look forward to feels pointless and I have little enthusiasm lately.
I cannot stop imagining that something terrible will happen even when nothing is wrong.
Most nights I am still awake at three in the morning and then I struggle to get up.
There are four assignments due this week and I cannot figure out where to begin.
Everyone else seems to have a group of friends. I have nobody to spend time with.
I am content, well rested and keeping up with university. I just want to see what resources exist.
I feel anxious about my unfinished dissertation and keep waking through the night.
I miss my family and feel alone here. My mood has been low as well.
I used to worry constantly but lately I feel calm. I am sleeping and studying comfortably.
My roommate has trouble sleeping, but I sleep well and feel fine. I am asking for general information.
I have friends and am not lonely. I need help breaking down the work for my research submission.
I am not feeling sad and I enjoy my activities, but I find it hard to get to sleep.
The timetable for tomorrow has been updated and the library closes at six.
I honestly cannot put what I am feeling into words right now.
I have people around me but do not feel I can confide in anyone, and it leaves me feeling isolated.
I feel dread throughout the day and my thoughts keep returning to unlikely disasters.
I spend ages in bed without feeling rested and I have stopped enjoying my hobbies.
Revision feels impossible to start. I also wish I had classmates I could talk to.
I’m worried about failing my exams; I don’t have a workable study plan.
I enjoyed meeting friends at the café and I am doing alright with my daily routine.
